method.neighbour_source: TIC v8 neighbours within 63 arcsec cached by diag_blend.py
method.assumptions: Gaussian PSF and circular aperture are approximate; the centroid floor is an assumption, so results are shown for several floors.
method.not_covered: sources not in the TIC; neighbours beyond 63 arcsec; the target's own companions

statuses.NO_VIABLE_NEIGHBOUR: No known star is both bright enough and consistent with the measured centroid.
statuses.UNSEPARABLE_NEIGHBOUR: A bright-enough neighbour sits so close that TESS pixels cannot tell it from the target. Needs ground-based follow-up.
statuses.VIABLE_NEIGHBOUR_AT_OFFSET: A bright-enough neighbour matches the measured offset.
